mines.mine_notes: 100% owned via subsidiaries PT Puncak Emas Tani Sejahtera (IUP-OP holder), PT Gorontalo Sejahtera Mining (Contract of Work holder) and PT Pani Bersama Tambang (processing and refining license holder). Low-cost open-pit mine on Mount Pani, Hulawa village, Pohuwato Regency, Gorontalo Province, Sulawesi. Phased development: heap leach (initial 8 Mtpa, first mining 1 Oct 2025, first gold production Feb 2026) and CIL plant (12 Mtpa targeted 1Q28; combined up to 19 Mtpa). FY2025: no gold production (pre-production; first 1,818 oz poured in Q1 2026). FY2026 guidance 100,000-115,000 oz at cash cost US$900-1,100/oz and AISC US$1,300-1,450/oz (excl. royalties and silver credits). Peak ~500 koz/year targeted by 2032. Project-to-date construction and pre-production spend US$259M at 31 Mar 2026.
mines.processing: Heap leach (8 Mtpa); CIL (12 Mtpa targeted 1Q28)

reserves_resources.notes: Consolidated ore reserves as of 31 Dec 2025 (EMAS Q1 2026 Quarterly Activities Report, 16 Mar 2026 statement). Up from 190.3 Mt @ 4.8 Moz reported Oct 2025 and 77.5 Mt @ 0.78 g/t Au (1.9 Moz Au, 2.9 Moz Ag) at end-2024. 100% of Pani asset.

Consolidated mineral resources as of 31 Dec 2025. 2024: 292.4 Mt @ 0.75 g/t Au, 0.70 g/t Ag (7.0 Moz Au, 6.6 Moz Ag). >80% in measured and indicated categories; ~74% reserve conversion (per Ajaib initiation). 100% of Pani asset.
